name: help-docs
title: In-IDE Documentation with .help()
description: All 16 NovaMP v1.0 classes support .help() — prints full signature, parameter list, and working examples directly in the REPL. No internet or external docs required.

pattern.workflow: When unsure about a class's API, call .help() first
pattern.rationale: Faster than searching docs — documentation is bundled with the firmware

code:
# Generic pattern
from <module> import <Class>
<Class>.help()

# Examples
from led import LED
LED.help()

from wifi import WiFi
WiFi.help()

from hcsr04 import HCSR04
HCSR04.help()

help_output_example.output:
【LED 驱动类】
--------------------
[硬件参数]:
    - 亮度范围: 0 (关闭) 到 1023 (最亮)
--------------------
[初始化]:
    led = LED(pin)                   # pin: machine.Pin 对象
[属性]:
    brightness: 当前亮度（可读写，范围 0~1023）
    is_on: 当前是否开启（只读）
[方法]:
    on()                             # 打开 LED 至当前亮度
    off()                            # 关闭 LED
    switch()                         # 切换 LED 状态
    ...
--------------------
[示例]:
    from machine import Pin
    from led import LED
    led = LED(Pin(4))
    led.brightness = 800
    led.on()

when_to_use.action: Run <Class>.help() — read parameter list and example
Run <Class>.help() — refresh memory on parameter names and order
Use .help() — documentation is bundled with firmware
Run .help() after firmware update — see new APIs

esp32_notes: .help() prints to stdout — works in any REPL (mpremote, Thonny, rshell)
Output is plain text — no formatting escapes that could break in serial terminals
Some classes have staticmethod help() (no instance needed), some have classmethod (also no instance)

comparison_to_documentation.feature: Always available offline, bundled with firmware
More detailed, includes examples and pitfalls
